name: Actual Harvest Projection
script:
# --- Get parameters from the API call (sent by frappe.call on the client) ---
greenhouse   = frappe.form_dict.greenhouse
crop_variety = frappe.form_dict.crop_variety
iso_year     = frappe.form_dict.year
week_no      = frappe.form_dict.week_no

# If year or week were not provided, default to "last week"
if not iso_year or not week_no:
    today = frappe.utils.now_datetime().date()
    iso   = today.isocalendar()       # (year, week, weekday)
    iso_year = iso[0] if not iso_year else iso_year
    week_no  = iso[1] - 1 if not week_no else week_no

# ---- Run the query for the specified greenhouse/variety/year/week ----
qty = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sed.qty), 0)
    FROM `tabStock Entry` se
    JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = se.name
    WHERE se.stock_entry_type = 'Harvesting'
      AND se.docstatus = 1
      AND se.custom_greenhouse = %s
      AND sed.item_name       = %s
      AND WEEK(se.posting_date, 1) = %s
      AND YEAR(se.posting_date)    = %s
""", (greenhouse, crop_variety, week_no, iso_year))[0][0]

# Return the result to the caller
frappe.response["message"] = qty
